arguments.value: Newly diagnosed symptomatic IgG-kappa multiple myeloma with severe infectious presentation, anemia, acute renal impairment, and marked hyperproteinemia, with 90% marrow plasma cell infiltration and t(11;14). Initial VRD/Dara-VRD produced only minimal response and was complicated by recurrent pneumonia and sulfonamide allergy; subsequent isatuximab-carfilzomib-dexamethasone with IVIG prophylaxis led to a rapid deep response and the patient is planned for autologous stem cell transplant.
